title: Using Debit Is Costing You $4,900 — Here's Why
hook: Sixty-five percent of Americans use their debit card daily thinking it's the responsible choice — but if someone drains your account tonight, federal law might not give you back a single dollar.
angle: Most people believe debit is safer than credit — the truth is the exact opposite, and the legal difference is shocking
audience: Anyone who uses a debit card as their primary payment method — 65% of American adults
key_numbers: $50 max credit card fraud liability (federal law)
10 business days for bank to investigate
65% of Americans use debit as primary card
